method.name: bake
method.description: Waits until the GPU has written the texture.

method.name: blank
method.description: Returns an Async, which holds the texture once the GPU has written it.

method.name: fill
method.description: Returns an Async, which is done once the GPU has written the array.

method.name: heights
method.description: Returns an Async, which holds the image once it's back from the GPU.

method.name: paint
method.description: Returns right away, while the GPU writes the texture.

method.name: scale
method.description: Returns an Async, which holds the values once they're back from the GPU.

method.name: seed
method.description: Returns an Async, which holds the array once the GPU has written it.
